heroHeadline: Transform Gabonese education with digital technology
heroDescription: A modular and secure SaaS platform designed to connect schools, teachers, learners and administrations within a unified ecosystem.
featuresSectionTitle: Everything you need to digitize education
featuresSectionSubtitle: EIGEN brings together all the tools needed to manage, monitor and improve teaching at the national scale.
featuresIamDesc: Integrated Keycloak with SSO, MFA and fine-grained role management per institution, department and hierarchy level.
featuresMultitenantDesc: Full data isolation per tenant with 3 strategies: schema, database or dedicated instance.
featuresPermissionsDesc: Action-level access control — define precisely who can read, write, approve or administer each resource.
featuresAnalyticsDesc: Visualize academic performance, attendance rates and key indicators in real time.
featuresMobileDesc: Responsive application optimized for limited mobile connections. PWA with built-in offline mode.
featuresApiDesc: Documented REST API, webhooks and ready-to-use connectors for your existing systems (ERPNext, Odoo, etc.).
featuresOfflineDesc: Designed for areas with limited connectivity in Gabon. Smart synchronization on reconnection.
featuresAiDesc: Integrated CIVITAS AI agents: automatic grading, dropout detection, pedagogical recommendations.
ucSectionTitle: A platform for every education stakeholder
ucSectionSubtitle: EIGEN adapts to the roles and needs of all stakeholders in the Gabonese education system.
ucMinistryDesc: Give the Ministry of Education a consolidated overview of all institutions, teachers and academic results across the country in real time.
ucMinistryF3: Budget and subsidy tracking by region
ucDirectorDesc: Manage your school or university from a single screen: enrollment, schedules, results, budget and parent communication.
ucTeacherDesc: Focus on pedagogy: EIGEN handles the administrative tasks — grades, absences, resources and communication in just a few clicks.
ucTeacherF1: Simplified grade and report card entry
ucTeacherF2: Attendance management via QR code or NFC
ucStudentTitle: A learning space centered on you
ucStudentDesc: Access your courses, results and assignments from any device, even in low-connectivity areas.
ucStudentF1: Access to online courses and resources
ucParentTitle: Stay close to your children's education
ucParentDesc: Monitor your children's grades, absences and school news in real time, directly on your phone.
ucParentF1: Real-time grade and report card tracking
ucParentF2: SMS/push alerts for absences and events
ucParentF4: School fee payment via Airtel Money
pricingSectionSubtitle: Start for free, grow at your own pace. All plans include updates and security.
pricingStarterDesc: Ideal for exploring EIGEN and validating your deployment.
pricingInstitutionDesc: For schools and universities ready to take the next step.
pricingNationalDesc: For ministries and institution networks at national scale.
pricingFootnote: * Prices in CFA Francs (XAF). Applicable VAT and taxes not included. Contact us for a custom quote for national deployment.
testimonialT1Quote: EIGEN transformed how we manage our network of institutions. Within weeks, we had full visibility across our 40 schools and their results.
testimonialT2Quote: Managing grades and absences used to take hours each week. With EIGEN, it's a matter of minutes. And parents receive everything in real time.
testimonialT3Quote: The offline mode was decisive for us. In our area, connectivity is unreliable. EIGEN still works — and syncs everything automatically.
testimonialT4Quote: With EIGEN, I can check my children's results from my phone. And I get an immediate alert for any absence. It's reassuring.
ctaSubtext: Join the institutions that have already chosen digital. Fast deployment, full support, measurable results.
footerTagline: The Digital Ecosystem for Education in Gabon. A CIVITAS initiative for African digital transformation.
